description:
Outcome: 3-6 repairers safely take next visitor and finish repairs, from BRIEF.md and owner usage.
Scope: Atomic oldest-waiting claim, helped-to-finished transition, harmless repeated finish, remove completed entries from active board. Excludes: accounts and named repairer assignments.
Acceptance: Concurrent claims never return the same visitor; only waiting visitors claimable; defined empty response; completed entries disappear.
Behaviour: Handle stale actions, rollover and timeouts; refresh after uncertain mutations before retrying.
Verification: Concurrent backend API and transition tests, including empty queue, repeats and rollover. Prerequisites: Q1 queue API. Assumptions: any repairer may finish an active repair.
Setup label: Q2.
title: Take next and finish repairs
